name: Graphics Tablet
summary: Drawing pad with an active area and a stylus lying on it; use for digital art and design scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom edge: the pad rests on y (set y to a desk top)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 520 px wide and 290 px deep (hero size)

params.name: ink
params.note: colour of the doodle on the active area

params.name: anim
params.note: draw = the doodle is drawn stroke by stroke
